Snippet.Name: ArubaOS-S SNMPv3 Configuration
Snippet.Description: Enable SNMPv3 with SHA/AES authentication and privacy, configure read-only group, restrict SNMPv1/v2c, and remove default initial user.
Snippet.Commands: ! Enable SNMPv3 protocol on the switch snmpv3 enable ! Define username, authentication protocol (SHA), and encryption protocol (AES) snmpv3 user "${SNMPv3 Username|text|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}$}" auth sha "${Auth Password|password|^.{8,64}$}" priv aes "${Privacy Password|password|^.{8,64}$}" ! Assign read-only group (operatorauth) to SNMPv3 user snmpv3 group operatorauth user "${SNMPv3 Username|text|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}$}" sec-model ver3 ! Read-only access for SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c (recommended) snmpv3 restricted-access ! Block SNMPv1 and v2c (recommended) snmpv3 only ! Remove default system-created user no snmpv3 user initial
